notes: Refunds, real .xlsx export, and app logging. Sales can now be refunded in one click from the transaction detail (full refund with stock restore and client balance adjustment, booked as a -R return invoice), and refund totals are visible everywhere: Reports stat card, Excel/PDF summaries, LAN stats and reports API (todayRefunds, monthRefunds, week refund series). Reports gained a true multi-sheet .xlsx export via the bundled SheetJS engine (falls back to the legacy .xls export if unavailable). The app now writes a rotating log at %APPDATA%\shop-ledger-ph\logs\shop-ledger.log (512KB per file, 3 rollovers) capturing app lifecycle, LAN server events, uncaught exceptions, renderer console errors and unhandled rejections - with a Logs card in Settings to inspect and open the folder.
